# 0005: Image derivatives are generated by a script and committed

**Status:** accepted

## Context

GitHub Pages serves files only, so the Next.js image optimizer is not available. Photos need AVIF and WebP at several widths. They could be generated on every build or generated once and committed.

## Decision

Source photos live in `assets/images/`. `scripts/build-images.ts` writes the derivatives to `public/images/` at fixed widths (640, 1024, 1600) in AVIF and WebP. The derivatives are committed. `pnpm build` does not run the script. A test checks that every image slot in the content module has all of its files.

## Consequences

- Builds and CI stay fast and do not depend on `sharp` compiling on the runner.
- The files that ship are the files that were reviewed.
- The site has only a handful of photos, so the repository cost is small. Revisit this if the count grows past a few dozen.
- Whoever changes a photo must run the script and commit the output. The test catches a missing file, though not a stale one.
